meta.description: States crossed by the route between two cities, besides the states of the two cities, on the roads of the Freight World map. Key "a|b" with the two city ids in alphabetical order (the same both ways); pairs that cross no other state are left out. Computed, not game data: the in-game road network may differ.
meta.method: shortest path on the road graph of data/map/ats-map.json, cut into pieces of at most 2 km; a state counts when at least 5 km of the path lie inside it
meta.source: Natural Earth 1:10m roads and admin-1 states (public domain), via data/map/ats-map.json
